statement: Everything lands on one undifferentiated list, so nothing feels urgent and the brain defaults to the easiest task.
desired_outcome: Know the few things that actually matter today.
solution_complaints: lists assume infinite time and just keep growing

sources.text: When everything is on the list nothing feels urgent; there is no differentiation between quick tasks and time-consuming projects, so easy tasks get done first.
